system.one_liner: Whole-song pop-music generation: a cascade of four diffusion models writes form, reduced lead sheet, lead sheet and accompaniment, each conditioned on upper levels.

content.variant_note: four stages in a 2x2 grid, one panel template reused per stage; the hand-over between stages is shown by colour and stacked strips, not by arrows
content.argues: Music is generated top-down in four cascaded diffusion stages; every stage conditions on all upper-level languages and, window by window, on its own earlier segments.
content.subject: Form, reduced lead sheet, lead sheet and accompaniment tracks drawn as colour-coded strips around one diffusion-model box per stage, with a shared legend.

layout.arrangement_note: Four equal stage panels in a 2x2 grid read in Z order, each with a white tab-like title box at its top-left corner, inside one thick outer frame; a full-height legend column at the right holds six headed groups of swatches. Every panel reuses one template: stack of known strips on top, context cards and noise strip in the middle, DM at the centre, output strip at the bottom.

encoding.color_means: hue = level of the hierarchical language (blue form, orange reduced lead sheet, yellow lead sheet, green accompaniment); saturation = status (saturated = current generation segment, pale = generated or known, speckled = Gaussian noise); grey = diffusion-model parts
encoding.line_style_means: dashed boxes bundle components (DM with x N, context cards, external controls) or mark the empty slot; dotted arrow and dotted diamond = optional external control; dotted vertical lines inside pale strips are unlabelled dividers
encoding.shape_means: grey square = diffusion model; solid diamond = cross-attention for autoregressive control; dotted diamond = cross-attention for external control; circle = external control signal; offset stack of strips = several hierarchy levels seen together
encoding.marker_means: Stage N orders the cascade; x N repeats the DM; braces with 256 measures, 128 beats or 128 steps give the window size at that level
encoding.emphasis: saturated colour marks what is generated now against pale known context; the stack of upper-level strips grows from one layer in stage 2 to three in stage 4, which shows the cumulative conditioning without arrows between stages

lessons.what_to_learn: Fix a legend of hue = level and tint = status, then repeat one identical panel per stage and stack pale strips of the upper levels behind the current strip, so cumulative conditioning shows without arrows between stages.
lessons.suits: coarse-to-fine or hierarchical cascades (music, layouts, multi-resolution generation) where each level conditions on upper levels and is produced window by window.

evidence: generating the four levels of hierarchical music languages one after another in a top-down order
A cascaded diffusion model is trained to model the hierarchical language, where each level is conditioned on its upper levels.
the generation at all the other layers are essentially conditional generation of music segments sliced from the entire sequences

summary: This ICLR 2024 paper generates whole pop songs in symbolic form with a cascade of four diffusion models, one per level of a hierarchical music language: form, reduced lead sheet, lead sheet and accompaniment. Figure 1 draws the cascade as four equal stage panels in a 2x2 grid plus a legend column. Each panel shows colour-coded track strips, a speckled Gaussian-noise strip entering a grey DM box (x N) and a bottom strip whose pale part is known music, whose saturated part is the segment being generated and whose dashed part is still empty. Pale strips of all upper levels stack behind the current one, so the conditioning grows from stage to stage; diamonds mark cross-attention for autoregressive and optional external control. Hue encodes the level and tint encodes the status.
summary_zh: 论文用四级级联扩散模型生成整首符号音乐，依次生成曲式、简化主旋律谱、主旋律谱和伴奏。图1用2×2四个阶段面板加右侧图例展示：每格有彩色音轨条、噪声条、DM框和交叉注意力菱形，颜色表示层级，深浅表示已知或当前生成，上层条带逐级叠加。
notes: Prior kinds (stage-pipeline, model-anatomy) kept. Prior panel count of 5 counted the legend column, which is treated here as a legend. The four panel interiors and the noise swatches are bitmaps; the legend, frames and titles are live vector and text. Palette hex values come from the vector fills of the legend. The x N, brace and ellipsis marks fit none of the marker kinds (order, identity, section) and are recorded as other. The dashed empty slot and the dotted strip dividers are unlabelled, so their meaning is only hedged.
